Tap Share in another app, choose PettiBox, pick a collection, then save. Several photos, PDFs or files shared together become one save. You can also highlight text in any app and choose \"Save to PettiBox\" from the selection menu. Add a note or reminder only when you need it.
Tap the + button on Home to add a note, paste a link, choose pictures, or pick one or more files.

Search by words, source app, file type, tag, collection, or upcoming reminders. It also checks text found inside images and PDFs (in the languages you turn on under Text recognition), and the text of articles saved for offline reading.
Use Collections above to create or rename shelves. New collections show up in Browse and in the save sheet.

Once you have more than 8 collections, a \"Find collection\" box appears when you save something, in Browse, and when you move a save (open it and tap Choose collection or Change, or long-press → Move to collection). Type a few letters to jump straight to the one you want.
Press and hold any save to pin, favorite, archive, set a reminder, move it, copy a link, or delete it.
Tap the heart on a save (or long-press → ❤️). Open Browse → Favorites to see every save you\'ve hearted, all in one place.
A save lives in one collection, but can carry many tags. Add tags from the save sheet or the detail screen. Open Browse → Tags to see every tag with its save count.
Open any save to change its title, note, or tags. Edits save automatically when you tap away or leave the screen, and a quick Undo appears in case you change your mind.
Anything you save stays in Browse → Unread until you open it, newest first. Once a week (Saturday morning) PettiBox can nudge you about one of them — turn that off under Reminders above.

Long-press the PettiBox icon for New note, Add a link, Search, or Unread. Add the PettiBox widget to your home screen (long-press an empty spot → Widgets) to see unread saves and add new ones in one tap.
Archived saves disappear from Home but stay searchable. Use Archive instead of Delete when you may need something again.
Tap the clock on any save or in the save sheet. Quick reminders use your Morning and Evening times above; Custom lets you pick the exact date and time.

When you save a link, PettiBox keeps a copy of the article\'s text. Open the save and tap \"Read offline\" — it works with no internet, even if the page is later changed or taken down. The copy is made in the background whenever you\'re online. Videos and social posts (YouTube, Instagram, X) don\'t have copies. Turn this off, or save older links too, under Offline reading above.

Links show the picture the website provides. If it has none, PettiBox takes a screenshot of the top of the page in the background, so you can spot the save by eye later. Not a helpful picture? Open the save and tap \"Use a page screenshot as the picture\".
Some pages can\'t be copied: paywalled or login-only articles, pages that no longer exist, and very long pages. Tap \"Try again\" on the save — or \"Open original\" to read it on the web.

Tap a picture to open it full screen, then pinch or double-tap to zoom and drag to look around. PDFs open right inside PettiBox: scroll through the pages, pinch to zoom, or tap the open-in-app icon to use another PDF app.

Auto-scan makes the text in screenshots, photos and PDFs searchable: English and other Latin-alphabet languages always, plus the languages you turn on under Text recognition › Languages in images. PDFs are read up to the page limit you choose there.
Open a saved item to share one attachment from a group, swipe through items, or remove an attachment with Undo.
Deleted saves wait in Browse → Recently deleted for 30 days. Tap one to restore it, or delete it for good. After 30 days they\'re removed automatically.

Turn on App lock under Privacy to require your fingerprint, face, or phone PIN. Pick how soon it locks again after you leave the app (a minute by default); locking your phone\'s screen locks it right away. The widget shows titles only while PettiBox is unlocked, and the weekly nudge never shows them.

Open a collection, tap Edit, and turn on \"Lock this collection\". It disappears from Home, Browse, search, and the widget. To see it again, tap Locked at the bottom of Browse (or Open under Privacy here) and unlock with your fingerprint, face, or phone PIN. It hides again when your screen locks. Want no trace of it in Browse? Turn off \"Show Locked in Browse\" under Privacy.

Turn on Sync between devices on each phone or tablet, signed in to the same Google account. Your library travels through your own Google Drive (a \"PettiBox\" folder). PettiBox syncs when you open it, about a minute after you change something, and in the background on the schedule you pick (15 minutes to weekly, or \"Only while in use\" for none). Photos and files follow, on Wi-Fi by default. Reminders ring on every device that has the save.

PettiBox has no servers. Your library lives on your phone and, with sync on, on your other devices and in your own Google Drive. Nobody else can see it. Turning sync off never deletes anything on the phone; you can also remove this phone\'s copy from Drive, or use \"Delete synced data\" to clear the synced data from Drive and stop sync on every device, while each device keeps its library.

If the same title, note or link was changed on two devices before they synced, both versions are kept. Open the save and pick the one to use; every device follows. A delete never wipes an edit made elsewhere: the save stays, and anything removed by sync waits in Recently deleted for 30 days. If another device wants to remove many saves at once, sync pauses and asks you first, after making a backup.

Every backup always keeps a copy on this phone; connect Google Drive (and optionally an extra folder) to send the same copy there too. \"Back up now\" fills every destination in one tap. Offline article copies are included, so they come back on a new phone too.

New phone, or need to recover? Tap \"Restore a backup\" in the Backup section and choose Google Drive, one of the automatic copies on this phone, or a backup file. Saves you already have are skipped, so nothing gets duplicated.
Coming from Chrome, Firefox, Raindrop.io, or Pocket? Export your bookmarks there (HTML or CSV), then use \"Import bookmarks file\" below. Folders and tags carry over.
Back up to your Google Drive

Connect Google Drive in the Backup section and every nightly safety copy also uploads to a \"PettiBox › Backups\" folder in your own Drive. PettiBox can only see files it created — never the rest of your Drive. Wrong account connected? Tap \"Switch account\" under Google Drive to pick a different one.
Ask for your fingerprint, face, or phone PIN to open PettiBox or save into it. The widget shows titles only while PettiBox is unlocked, and notifications hide them.

resources.string: Keep the same library on your phones and tablets. PettiBox has no servers: your library stays on your devices, and they keep in step through your own Google Drive, in a \"PettiBox\" folder. Nothing passes through anyone else, and we can\'t see your saves.
Reconnect Google Drive to keep syncing
Photos and files are waiting for Wi-Fi.
Photos and files are waiting for the battery to charge.

Changes from your other devices wait until you choose; your own changes still go out. Apply here too moves them to Recently deleted or Archive on this phone as well (a backup is made first). Put them back undoes it on every device.
While PettiBox is open, changes go both ways within seconds. This is for when it\'s closed.
Photos and files on Wi-Fi only
Off: photos and files sync on any connection, right along with your saves. On: they wait for Wi-Fi, to save mobile data.
How your other devices see this one

Where your library lives: on this phone, on your other devices, and in your own Google Drive. PettiBox has no servers. Changes reach your other devices the next time they sync. If a save is edited on two devices at once, both versions are kept: open the save to pick one. Deleted saves go to Recently deleted on every device, and leave every device when it\'s emptied.
Turn off sync on this device?
This phone stops sending and receiving changes. Everything on it stays, and your other devices keep syncing.
Also remove this phone\'s copy from Google Drive
For a phone you\'re giving away or no longer use. Your other devices still have everything.
Delete synced data from Google Drive?

This deletes the sync data in the \"PettiBox\" folder of your Google Drive (PettiBox › Sync), with every device\'s copy and the synced photos and files, and turns sync off on all your devices.\n\nNothing is deleted from any phone: each keeps its own library. Your Drive backups aren\'t touched. You can turn sync on again later to start fresh.
Removes its copy from Google Drive, for a phone you no longer use. Your library stays on your other devices. If it syncs again, it comes back.
English, Spanish, Portuguese, French, German, Indonesian, Vietnamese, Turkish and other Latin-alphabet languages are always read. Turn on the others you save text in.

Each one downloads once (1–5 MB) and then works offline. Text recognition runs on your phone; if you turn on sync or Drive backup, your files are also copied to your Google Drive. Turning one on reads your saved images and PDFs again, so older saves are found too.
Reading your saved images and PDFs again…
PettiBox is built with these open-source components. Tap one to read its license. Text recognition also uses Google ML Kit, under Google\'s ML Kit terms.
